# 3 Storms

In a storm the light matters most.[^1]
A wreck was his failure, whatever the weather.[^2]
He stayed at the lamp (in 1839, for nine days) through every gale.[^3]

[^2]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#Storms]] "failure, whatever the weather"
